verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an API-first payments platform. Its own Rainforest API runs headlessly through long-lived server API keys, with an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec and an end-to-end sandbox, so server-side automation without the UI is documented. Nothing addresses CI pipelines specifically. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration or guidance, an official CLI or headless test runner, hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: An API key is a long-lived credential that authorizes servers to communicate with the Rainforest API.
Rainforest supports OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) of the Rainforest API, version 3.1.0.
full end-to-end sandbox testing, realtime API logs
